task_completion.description: Weasis medical viewer is open with a CT image loaded in the main viewport.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Weasis application window is visible showing a cross-sectional medical CT scan.

task_completion.description: A visible annotation (e.g., arrow, circle, text, or measurement) has been placed on the CT image.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A graphical overlay or markup (like a yellow circle or arrow) is visible on top of the medical image in the viewer.

task_completion.description: The agent has opened the export or 'Save As' dialog specifically for DICOM Secondary Capture.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An export dialog box is visible, likely showing options for 'DICOM' or 'Secondary Capture'.

task_completion.description: The export destination is set to ~/DICOM/exports/surgical_plan.dcm.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The file path field in the export dialog shows '~/DICOM/exports/surgical_plan.dcm' or the equivalent absolute path '/home/ga/DICOM/exports/surgical_plan.dcm'.

task_completion.description: The agent selected the 'Secondary Capture' (current view) option rather than a standard DICOM export.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the export settings, a checkbox or radio button for 'Secondary Capture' or 'Current View' is selected.

task_completion.description: The agent completes the export process.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A progress bar for exporting appears, or the export dialog closes after clicking 'Export' or 'Save'.

integrity.description: The agent used the Weasis GUI to perform the task rather than just using the terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with Weasis menus and toolbars, not just a terminal window.

integrity.description: The agent did not use 'touch' or 'cp' in the terminal to create a dummy file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The terminal history (if visible) does not show commands creating the target .dcm file manually.

integrity.description: The annotation is a result of using the Weasis drawing tools.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Weasis toolbar shows an active drawing tool (like the 'Draw' icon highlighted) while the annotation is being placed.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires exporting a DICOM Secondary Capture (SOP Class UID 1.2.840.10008.5.1.4.1.1.7). The agent must use the Weasis GUI to add a visible markup to the CT image and save it specifically to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/surgical_plan.dcm. Ensure the agent selects the 'Secondary Capture' or 'Current View' option in the export menu to capture the annotation.
